title: The old desert road.
content: Have you dreamt of traversing a worn down road through the desert to get where you're going in Mall World? Often the asphalt has been covered in sands, there are unmapped shortcuts through canyons and dirt trails. Sometimes when the sun dips down a strip club or old Western brothel that has somehow been perfectly preserved in an eternal nocturnal temporal bubble appears on the road where it wasn't before during the daytime. There are tiny hotels every so often no bigger than a living room for travelers seeking rest on the old desert road. Sometimes there are literal poison clouds and acid pools to avoid. You may have even seen or rode on a ghost train that like the brothel seems to exist in eternal night and can secret you away to all the other hidden places that are impossible to see during the day.
